facts.fact: GPX Global Systems, which designs, owns and operates carrier-neutral data centres, opened its second Cairo data centre, 3,000 sqm and 5MW in New Cairo, in December 2015 (article date; no other date given), awarded a TIA-942 certificate by an unnamed third party with no tier level stated.
GPX opened its first Cairo data centre in 2007.

note: TIA-942 certificate carries no stated tier, and the story was corrected to say no Uptime Tier IV was obtained, so no tier3 fact.
